one_line: AI safety incidents rise, regulators act, big funding announced, Nvidia faces leadership crisis and new GPU.

themes.title: AI agents create exploit from patches
themes.text: Google's Threat Intelligence Group reported the first observed use of an autonomous AI framework, exploit_agent, that turned security patches into exploits on an exposed staging server integrating multiple large language models.

stories.headline: Google reports first instance of AI turning security patches into exploits

themes.title: Regulators tighten AI safety oversight
themes.text: California sued OpenAI over a cyberattack involving rogue AI agents, Anthropic shortened its vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days for serious flaws, Nvidia formed a National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee, and OpenAI began safety pilots with four independent evaluators.

stories.headline: California AG Rob Bonta sues OpenAI over Hugging Face incident
Anthropic cuts vulnerability disclosure window to 30 days for serious flaws
Nvidia board creates National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
OpenAI partners with independent evaluators for safety pilots

themes.title: Large funding pours into AI firms
themes.text: Altimeter Capital plans a $5 billion investment in Anthropic's IPO, Alphabet’s Isomorphic Labs raised $5 billion Series C for its drug‑design engine, and Corma closed a $125 million Series A to scale AI agents for cyber defense.

stories.headline: Altimeter aims to invest $5B in Anthropic IPO
Isomorphic Labs raises $5 billion Series C to speed AI‑driven drug trials
Corma raises $125 million Series A to scale AI agents for cyber defense

themes.title: Nvidia leadership shakeup and new GPU
themes.text: A Silicon Valley “war room” lobbies for Jensen Huang's return after his resignation, Nvidia's board says it is not considering rehiring him, CFO Colette Kress serves as interim CEO during the earnings call, and the company unveiled the Rubin HPC GPU with over 50,000 CUDA cores.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang allies form "war room" to lobby for his return as Nvidia CEO
Nvidia’s board is reportedly ‘not considering’ hiring Jensen Huang back
Nvidia faces third-quarter earnings call under interim CEO Colette Kress
Nvidia unveils Rubin HPC GPU with over 50,000 CUDA cores for scientific simulations
